text:
Maria L: Heads up — quickstart hello-lite guide needs a small auth update: token env var names changed in SDK 0.9.3. PR ready but want docs review before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Sam T: Thanks — saw failing CI. Which env var should we show in examples? OLD: REDWOOD_API_KEY vs NEW: REDWOOD_TOKEN?
Jordan P: New SDK uses `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` (semver bump). We should update the JS/Python snippets and the env example.
Maria L: Yep. Current hello-lite app uses `Authorization: Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` — I'll change that to `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`. Left a note in the PR about keeping a short migration note.
DevEx Bot: :warning: build failed on docs lint — link-checker flagged https://old-link.example.com/hello as 404 in the quickstart reference.
Kevin R: I can fix the broken link on the reference page. Also suggest adding a one-line migration tip: "If you used REDWOOD_API_KEY, set REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=REDWOOD_API_KEY" for a smooth transition.
Ashley M: :thumbsup: small UX ask — under "first deployment" step we should call out CORS for localhost when users try Dedicated. Added a comment to the PR.
Sam T: Could we keep a fallback in code samples to minimize breakage? e.g. `const token = process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;`
Maria L: Good idea. I'll update the JS and add the equivalent in Python:
```python
import os
TOKEN = os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_TOKEN') or os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
```
Maria L: Also adding a short migration note and fixing the 404 link + CORS mention. Pushed changes to the PR branch. CI passed on my fork. Requesting review @Sam T @Jordan P @Kevin R
Sam T: :eyes: Reviewing now. Quick check — are we keeping the sample headers as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`?
Maria L: Yes, header format unchanged. Only env var name updated + fallback in code snippets.
Jordan P: LGTM overall. One nit: use `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` as the canonical name in the sidebar quick reference to encourage the new name.
Kevin R: I'll run link-check and preview deploy after merge to confirm no 404s.
DevEx Bot: PR merged by Maria L — deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/842 (status: success)
Maria L: Thanks all — closing the thread.
